growth: log10_stellar_mass - log10_main_prog_stellar_mass, a cumulative log mass ratio, not a time-normalized rate
estimator: 20 training-fold stellar-mass quantile bins; mean growth per bin at median mass; linear interpolation between nodes, constant outside training node range; duplicate quantile edges removed
fitting: Fit reference curve only on each CV training fold, using input features only, no SFR. Transform training and validation with the same frozen curve. Refit on original training 80% for saved artifacts.
comparison: Add exactly one feature (34 -> 35). Same source catalogue sorting and original training 80%, KFold(5,shuffle=True,random_state=42), HGB400 lr=.08 leaves31 no early stopping, zero threshold .9.
baseline: Previously verified OOF predictions from leader_three_regime_experiment; validate source rows, labels and fold mapping before reuse
holdout: Not scored or used for feature fitting, candidate selection or model fitting
production: Save candidates and report; do not overwrite the current model or push
